For q-80136, coefficient matching gives tan(phi)=8/2=4, so phi=arctan(4), interpreted in degrees as requested. For q-107570 and q-80138, equal positive sine and negative cosine coefficients give phase 45 degrees and amplitudes sqrt(10) and 4sqrt(2), respectively. For q-107579, tan(phi)=(2sqrt(2))/(2sqrt(6))=1/sqrt(3), so phi=pi/6. For q-51145, clearing denominators gives coefficients B-2=-3 and 4-B=5, both yielding B=-1. For q-49723, coefficient matching gives A+C=0, B-2A=7, and -2B+3C=0; hence A=-2, B=3, C=2 and their sum is 3. For q-102561, matching coefficients gives A+C=3, 5A+B=2, and 5B+6C=-3, yielding A=1, B=-3, C=2.
